proposals.evidence: Turner prajvalati gives Hindi pajalnā/pajarnā catch fire, distinct from the transitive prajvālayati. These Tharu intransitive pajar- responses and participial endings match that fire-catching verb; clipped pa and extra-copula clauses are excluded.
